component_specs.name: button

density.rule: tight component internals, generous section rhythm
density.wash: event/detail ground = surface mixed with active accent ~7% (light) / ~12% (dark)

architecturalPillars.description: Every critical dependency is sovereign. Speed is rented, truth is owned.

covenants: We will never sell your personal data.
We will never design for addiction.
We will never let advertisers control what you see.
We will never abandon African creators.
We will never choose proprietary when open source is adequate.
We will never treat African languages as an afterthought.
We will never abandon our values when growth demands it.
philosophy.description: Every decision we make, every feature we build, every line of code we write runs through a single filter: does this strengthen the community, or does it extract from it?
philosophy.name: Ubuntu

ubuntuQuestions: Does this serve the collective good?
Would we explain this proudly to our elders?
Does this align with 'I am because we are'?

radii.system: Ecosystem numbers: 7, 12, 14, 17. Buttons are always pill (rounded-full).

doList: Use lowercase for all brand wordmarks (mukoko, nyuchi, shamwari, bundu, nhimbe)
Reference African origins and meanings when contextually appropriate
Write in a way that welcomes both technical and non-technical readers
Use inclusive language that reflects Ubuntu philosophy
dontList: Don't capitalize brand wordmarks (not Mukoko, not NYUCHI)
Don't use overly formal or corporate language
principles: Speak like a knowledgeable friend, not a corporation
Use simple, clear language — avoid jargon
Be warm and encouraging, never condescending
Respect African cultural context and diversity
Prefer active voice and direct address
